_doc: Uncovered units (statements never executed + branches taken in only one direction + lines excluded by a `# pragma: no cover`) per hard-rule surface, as measured by the FULL suite under `coverage run` AGAINST A FRESHLY MIGRATED AND SEEDED DATABASE — the sequence CI runs. The database's contents change which branches execute, so a measurement taken against a long-lived dev database is a different number and will fail this gate in one direction or the other; run `make db-reset` first, or take CI's. The gate is an EQUALITY: more is a regression, less is an improvement that must be locked in here. Written only by `make coverage-ratchet-accept`, which refuses to grow a number without a RAISED_BUDGETS waiver in scripts/check_coverage_ratchet.py. See that file's docstring for why this is a count per area and not a repo-wide percentage.
